futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2025 Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda

entries.quote: By 2026, 75% of G1000 Organizations Will Adopt Value-Based AI Economics Models Covering Tech Acquisition Cost, Productivity Gains, Decision-Making, and Innovation, or Risk Missing New ROI Benchmarks
entries.subject: AI economics models
entries.metric: share of G1000 adopting value-based AI economics models

entries.quote: By 2027, Without Strategic and Organizational Pivots, Frustration with Low ROI Due to Poor Planning and Misallocated Spending Will Cause 30% of Organizations to Reduce GenAI Investments
entries.subject: GenAI investment pullback
entries.metric: share of organizations reducing GenAI investments

entries.quote: By 2027, Regulations and the Need to Ensure Availability for AI-Enhanced Apps Will Force 65% of CIOs to Adopt Unified Cyber-Recovery and HA Practices Across Their Infrastructure, Data, and AI Platforms
entries.subject: Cyber-recovery and high availability
entries.metric: share of CIOs adopting unified cyber-recovery and HA practices

entries.quote: By 2027, More than 60% of Businesses Will Have Modernized up to 50% of Their Cloud Architecture to Encourage Infrastructure and Cost Efficiency and Enable Business and Technical Innovation
entries.subject: Cloud architecture modernization
entries.metric: share of businesses that modernized up to 50% of cloud architecture

entries.quote: By 2026, the Use of Data-as-a-Product Architectures Will Significantly Break Down Data Silos in 50% of Large Enterprises
entries.subject: Data-as-a-product architectures
entries.metric: share of large enterprises where data-as-a-product breaks down silos

entries.quote: By 2025, 50% of Organizations Will Use Enterprise Agents Configured for Specific Business Functions, Instead of Focusing on Individual Copilot Technologies to Achieve Faster Business Value from AI
entries.subject: Enterprise AI agents
entries.metric: share of organizations using function-specific enterprise agents

entries.quote: By 2028, 80% of Enterprises Will Require Providers of AI-Enabled Products to Enable Diversified Delivery of Inferencing from Core to End Device with Tunable Cost and Digital Sovereignty Guardrails
entries.subject: Diversified AI inferencing
entries.metric: share of enterprises requiring diversified inferencing delivery

entries.quote: By 2026, 60% of Enterprises Will Implement Sustainable AI Frameworks, Leveraging Data-Driven Decisions to Scale AI Operations Across Datacenter Locations While Meeting Decarbonization Goals
entries.subject: Sustainable AI frameworks
entries.metric: share of enterprises implementing sustainable AI frameworks

entries.quote: By Early 2028, 75% of Composite AI Apps Used by Enterprises Will Be Constructed on a Unified Platform Framework That Ensures Trusted and Efficient Use of Code, Data, and Infrastructure Resources
entries.subject: Unified AI platforms
entries.metric: share of enterprise composite AI apps built on a unified platform framework

entries.quote: Driven by the Adoption of New AI-Enabled Work Models, 95% of Current IT and LOB Job Roles Will Be Redefined or Eliminated by 2030
entries.subject: AI and job roles
entries.metric: share of IT and LOB job roles redefined or eliminated

entries.quote: In 2025, 50% of the G1000 Will Struggle with Divergent Regulatory Changes and Rapidly Evolving Compliance Standards, Challenging Their Ability to Adapt to Market Conditions and Drive AI Innovation
entries.subject: Regulatory divergence
entries.metric: share of G1000 struggling with divergent regulatory changes

entries.quote: By 2025, 85% of Organizations Will Be Formalizing Policies and Oversight to Address AI Risks (e.g., Ethical, Brand, and PII), Aligning AI Governance with Strategic Business Goals
entries.subject: AI governance policies
entries.metric: share of organizations formalizing AI risk policies and oversight

entries.quote: Responding to the Drag of Technical Debt, 40% of CIOs in 2025 Will Drive Enterprise Initiatives in High-Impact Areas to Remediate Technical Debt for Competitive Advantage
entries.subject: Technical debt remediation
entries.metric: share of CIOs driving technical debt remediation initiatives

entries.quote: In 2026, Over One-Third of Organizations Will Be Stuck in the Experimental, Point-Solution Phase of AI Experimentation, Requiring a Shift of Focus to Enterprise Use Cases to Deliver ROI
entries.subject: AI stuck in experimentation
entries.metric: share of organizations stuck in experimental point-solution AI phase

entries.quote: By 2026, 80% of CIOs Will Lead the Creation of a Strategic Road Map to Rapidly Implement Responsible AI Solutions, Maximizing Benefits While Mitigating Risks Across Their Operations
entries.subject: Responsible AI road maps
entries.metric: share of CIOs leading a responsible AI road map

entries.quote: In 2026, 55% of CIOs Will Diversify and Broaden Security Strategies Across Their Organization's IT and Security Teams to Address New/Fast-Evolving Threats to Their Technology and Supply Chain Ecosystem
entries.subject: Security strategy diversification
entries.metric: share of CIOs diversifying security strategies

entries.quote: By 2027, 65% of CIOs Will Be Accountable for Embedding Sustainability Goals into Every Technology Project, Measuring Outcomes to Refine Investments and Align with Environmental Objectives
entries.subject: Sustainability in technology projects
entries.metric: share of CIOs accountable for embedding sustainability goals in technology projects

entries.quote: Just 50% of Organizations in 2027 Will Be Able to Effectively Use AI-Infused Applications to Improve Incident Detection and Resolution Processes, Making Them More Cyber-Resilient Organizations
entries.subject: AI for incident detection
entries.metric: share of organizations effectively using AI-infused apps for incident detection and resolution

entries.quote: Due to Rising Pressures, 80% of G1000 CIOs Will Be Hired from Outside Their Organization by 2028, Requiring CIOs to Expand Skills in Digital Innovation, Strategic Leadership, and Industry Versatility
entries.subject: External CIO hiring
entries.metric: share of G1000 CIOs hired from outside the organization

entries.quote: By 2028, 50% of G1000 Will Adopt Cutting-Edge Tools to Close the Digital and AI Skills Gap, Easing Reliance on Specialized Talent, Boosting the Workforce, and Bridging the Expertise Gap for Innovation
entries.subject: Digital and AI skills tools
entries.metric: share of G1000 adopting tools to close the digital and AI skills gap
